info.name: Flow Notifications
info.description:
The Flow Notifications app adds a **Send a notification** action to Nextcloud Flow. It automates generating customized notifications for events that match configured rules.
Choose an event and conditions, and optionally provide a title prefix to help identify the resulting notification.
## How it works
When personal flows are enabled, users can configure notification rules in their personal Flow settings.
Each rule group combines its conditions with AND: the group matches only when all its conditions match. Each matching group can trigger a notification. Events include file activity and tag assignment; conditions include MIME type, time ranges, upload size, and more.
For example, configure a flow for the **File updated** event with a MIME type condition of `application/pdf` and the optional title "PDF updated". When another user updates a matching PDF you can access, your flow can notify you.
## Considerations
* Notifications are skipped when the current session user is the flow owner. For example, updating a file in your own session will not notify you through your own flow. * Ensure that the [Notifications](https://github.com/nextcloud/notifications) app is installed and enabled. It is required for Flow Notifications to register its action. * The notification action is available for personal flows, not administrator-scoped flows.
For general configuration guidance, see the [Nextcloud Flow documentation](https://docs.nextcloud.com/server/stable/go.php?to=admin-workflowengine). Discover more about Nextcloud Flow at [https://nextcloud.com/workflow](https://nextcloud.com/workflow).
![Configuring a notification flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/flow_notifications/master/screenshots/configuration.png) ![A flow notification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/flow_notifications/master/screenshots/notification.png)
